help.title: Help
help.subtitle: Frequently asked questions and how to reach us.
help.email_copied: Couldn't open your email app. We've copied {email} so you can paste it wherever you like.
help.faq_currency_q: How do I change the currency?
help.faq_currency_a: Go to Profile > Currency and pick EUR, USD, GBP or BRL. Every amount in the app switches to that currency.
help.faq_theme_q: How do I switch between light and dark mode?
help.faq_theme_a: Go to Profile > Theme and choose Light, Dark or Automatic (follows your system setting).
help.faq_language_q: How do I change the app language?
help.faq_language_a: Go to Profile > Language and pick Portuguese or English. The app switches straight away, no restart needed.
help.faq_notifications_a: Not yet — the preferences under Profile > Notifications are stored on your device only. Push notifications are coming in a future update.
help.faq_desire_q: How does money saved towards a goal work?
help.faq_desire_a: When you create or edit a goal you can say how much you've already put aside for it. That amount is automatically deducted from your balance.
help.faq_events_q: When does a calendar event count towards my balance?
help.faq_events_a: Only on the day it's set for. Until then it's just a reminder: when the date arrives, the event becomes a regular transaction, and that's when it changes your balance and shows up in your expenses.
help.faq_statement_q: How do I import transactions from my bank?
help.faq_statement_a: Go to Profile > Import transactions from your bank and pick the PDF or CSV you downloaded from your online banking. The file is read on your phone and you can review everything before saving.
help.faq_password_q: How do I change my account password?
help.faq_password_a: Go to Profile > Security, enter your current password and the new one to confirm the change.
